comment: Ratchet budgets for the whole-pattern-corpus Solidity compile suite. 'condition_todo_occurrences' counts every 'false /* TODO' occurrence (if/while/require contexts). Lower a budget when a change improves the metric; do not raise one without recording why in logs/. RAISED for the flattened shape (the only shape the pipeline produces since 2026-09-23, when the pre-inlining mode switch was removed -- see logs/20260923-04-remove-evm-inline-switch.md): the calldata chains are expanded before type recovery, so the shared bound/revert scaffolding is duplicated per call site and the structurer emits more gotos/TODOs. The raise and the pre-inlining numbers are recorded in logs/20260920-02-evm-entry-poly-worklist-blowup-root-cause.md section 11.11. The helper floors are anchored to the flattened counts; the pre-inlining floors were 1339/1301. LOWERED on 2026-09-22 after the Phoenix reduceSequenceOnce continuation fix (logs/20260922-02-structurer-terminal-arm-join-fix.md): goto 5437->3640, real jumps 4604->3175, dangling 501->55, condition TODO 4647->4303, and the helper_call_sites floor 2412->2408 because structured bodies no longer repeat helper call statements across goto copies. RE-ANCHORED on 2026-09-22 after the entry-continuation fix (logs/20260922-03-entry-continuation-and-block-order-fix.md): the wide continuation rule plus entry-first block order in collapseNodes removes the goto flood for good (goto 3640->1787, real jumps 3175->1695, condition TODO 4303->4078, helper_call_sites 2408->2442), so those budgets are lowered to the new actuals. The two raised budgets are direct consequences of no longer dropping the function entry node: dangling 55->58 because the additionally recovered blocks include guard-revert branches whose '// block_N:' label the renderer folds into require(), and unresolved 289->297 because the previously lost entry-block statements (which carry the bound checks) are rendered again. RE-ANCHORED on 2026-09-23 after the source-cases regression fix (logs/20260923-05-source-cases-follow-absorb-fix.md): a region no longer folds the placeholder node that models its exit, finalize re-points entering edges at the final structured root, a natural-loop region is entered at its head for the dominance analysis, and a guard that skips the following loop nests it instead of emitting a goto. That recovers control flow that used to be dropped or flattened: goto 1787->1192, real jumps 1695->1111, dangling 58->5, unresolved 297->289, helper_call_sites 2442->2421. condition TODO is RAISED 4078->4494: every branch that is now rendered as an if/while needs a condition expression, and the conditions of the newly recovered guards/latches are often still unresolved by type recovery, so a goto or a dropped guard turns into 'false /* TODO'. The increase is spread over exactly the cases whose goto counts fell (per-case table in the log); the condition work belongs to the type-recovery line, not to the structurer. LOWERED on 2026-09-24 after dynamic calldata tail recovery (logs/20260924-02-dynamic-bytes-length.md): EvmCalldataAccessPass annotates the length word of a dynamic argument (the load at head + 4) and the Solidity backend renders it as <arg>.length for bytes/string, so the guards and returns over bytes calldata no longer collapse to TODO: condition TODO 4494->4440, unresolved 289->288. The string-valued case is pinned in notdec.evm.solidity_source (dynamic_bytes_length_01). RE-ANCHORED on 2026-09-24 after the Yul-escape intrinsic prototype (logs/20260924-03-yul-escape-intrinsics.md): every rewritten calldata word load carries a notdec.solidity.calldata.raw marker and the Solidity backend falls back to a __evm_calldataload intrinsic (an internal pure function with an inline-assembly body emitted once per contract) when neither the ABI head slot nor the dynamic length resolves.  The ABI decoder's offset checks are now representable and compile instead of turning into TODO: condition TODO 4440->3452, unresolved 288->216, and helper_call_sites 2421->2751 because call arguments that used to be unresolved now render.  goto/real/dangling are unchanged and no case got worse. LOWERED on 2026-09-26 after the memory/storage/callvalue escape step (logs/20260926-01-memory-storage-escape-intrinsics.md): __evm_mload/__evm_sload/__evm_sha3/__evm_msize, plus __evm_callvalue for the payability guard that InstCombine rewrites into '<cond>.not', turn the remaining low-level word reads into representable values.  condition TODO 3452->3211, unresolved 216->155, real jumps 1111->1110; the helper floors move up to 1548/3125 because escape-clean helper bodies are now emittable (the SSTORE escape added in the same step also brings 189 previously dropped storage writes back into the output at no metric cost).  RAISED dangling 5->6 in the same step: case 24612's helper-call blocks are no longer empty, so the structurer keeps a branch whose revert block the renderer folds into require(); the jump survives as a diagnostic '// goto block_12' whose label the fold removed.  The alternative was the previous behaviour, where the whole branch (and its checked arithmetic) was silently dropped. LOWERED/RE-ANCHORED on 2026-09-26 after the via-ir switch and the tuple/SSA-slot/CALL-escape step (logs/20260926-03-via-ir-tuples-and-slots.md). The compile net now runs solc with --via-ir by default: Stack too deep comes from the EVM's 16-slot DUP/SWAP reach, not from a front-end rule, and the generated decompiler output legitimately needs many locals (SSA demotion slots, tuple returns); the front-end error classes this suite catches are identical under both pipelines (measured: 5 stack-too-deep cases go 1 error -> 0, single-file cost 0.02s -> 0.54s).  With the limit gone, multi-word helpers return Solidity tuples destructured at the call site, demoteSSA slots render as locals, and the EVM CALL family goes through escape intrinsics: condition TODO 3211->3159, unresolved 155->139, helper floors up to 1612/3449.  RAISED goto 1192->1193 and real jump 1110->1111 in the same step: those extra statements make one previously empty block non-empty, so the structurer keeps a branch it used to fold away (case 0448). LOWERED/RE-ANCHORED on 2026-09-26 after inverting the demoted-slot acceptance rule (logs/20260926-04-slot-taint-and-solc-fallback.md).  The rule now starts with every SSA-demotion slot addressable and removes the ones whose stores stay unresolved, instead of adding slots that are already clean: a loop counter's store reads the slot of the value it increments and that slot's store reads the counter's, so the add-only fixed point could never accept either and the three biggest cases (0029/0114/0726, half of all condition TODOs) stayed frozen.  condition TODO 3159->2541, unresolved 139->134, goto 1193->1189, real jumps 1111->1107, helper floors up to 1738/3713.  The compile net now tries the legacy pipeline first and falls back to --via-ir: the front-end checks are identical, and case 0146 only compiles under one of the two (solc's IR pipeline throws an uncaught StackTooDeepError).
